coverage_limitations: This is complete manual mechanism extraction of the received CONCEPTS/SOURCES notes,not of the underlying books/papers or every repo document.
Feature/code presence is distinguished from a costed,registered portfolio test; unknown parameters remain explicit formalization blockers.
Weak ICT/SMT,disputed flow,and under-specified ideas remain visible; source conflicts such as ALT01 minus-sign vsR219 plus-sign are retained.
Study/idea counts are not measured-market trial counts; historical date reuse and survivor selection remain material.

Three received-source files differ on the current branch; their added sections are flagged for review rather than silently treated as ingested. Current canonical queue priority/status remains outside this bundle.

Video and public-source intake is limited to accessible captions, official transcripts/recaps, documentation, repository descriptions or indexed summaries; several videos have no verified full transcript. All media claims are leads only, never strategy performance evidence.
scope_notice: Manual catalog of the explicitly received documents plus two targeted public-media discovery batches (56 public sources total). Every retained lead preserves source basis, exact tested/open scope, aliases and missing mechanics; counts are not measured-market trials. The later account review is bounded separately in supplemental_intakes; it does not claim complete channel coverage. XM26 entries are our finite proposals, not exchange-recommended trading rules or measured results. The M283 follow-up audits one pinned secondary implementation; it does not add a method or validate performance. The 2026-10-23 reel delta reads two supplied public captions plus bounded official Citadel/Jane Street page metadata; the full Jane Street speech was not accessible and no reel audio was transcribed.

status_definitions.untested: No completed test of the specified remaining rule; may need mechanical definition.
status_definitions.blocked: Remaining rule needs named inputs or a precise definition before a valid run.
status_definitions.partial: Related or descriptive evidence exists,with explicit exact-rule differences or incomplete stages.
status_definitions.null: The exact linked frozen study/family failed its declared bar; does not falsify its broad parent mechanism.
status_definitions.forward: An existing frozen prospective paper/measurement lane,without assumed completion or promotion.
status_definitions.confirmed_original: Passed the linked original study decision only; not current live-trading approval.

Component conservatism is not a guarantee that every combined exchange fill is conservative.

methods.title: Deterministic probability-based MBP queue-position update
methods.hypothesis: An explicit simulator assumption to compare/calibrate, not a directional signal or validated fill model.
methods.testable_rule: Keep front and cumulative same-price trade size. Trades subtract from front and accumulate. Depth change subtracts accumulated trades before estimating cancellation to avoid double counting; reset accumulator. If residual change<0, clamp to new depth. Otherwise front=f, back=prev_qty-f, p=probability of decrease BEHIND; newfront=min(f-(1-p)*change+min(back-p*change,0),new_qty). Infinite p is replaced by 1. Fill availability uses rounded negative front/lot size; positive availability resets front to 0. This is a deterministic estimate, not sampled queue truth.

methods.hypothesis: An explicit simulator assumption to compare/calibrate, not a directional signal or validated fill model.

GTC walks depth but FORCES all remaining quantity filled at the limit; source acknowledges unreality. Buy GTC walk excludes limit tick; sell includes it. Selected fill/ack methods do not consume replay depth.

input_definitions.definition: SplyCur * daily-close PriceUSD: value of current ledger supply, including illiquid escrow/foundation holdings. This differs from estimated circulating capitalization.
Reported/derived circulating supply * daily-close PriceUSD. Supply uses third-party/project APIs, including CoinGecko/Etherscan paths; it is not a direct ledger-total supply measure.

De-duplicated recipient/originator addresses involved in ledger changes during the interval. Protocol-specific zero-value, self and failed-transaction handling matters. Addresses are not people, holder concentration or search/social attention.

Current issued supply in native units at interval end: UTXOs or account balances, with chain-specific exceptions. Includes XRP escrow and ZEC shielded pools. Stock measurement does not establish publication time.

availability.interval_time: The four UpperCamelCase asset metrics label the beginning of their UTC interval. time+1d is an interval-end floor; publication follows calculation and may be later. No historical as-of or release time follows from this lag.
availability.completion_time: AssetEODCompletionTime is asset-level last-metric calculation completion, not per-value original publication or revision history. Its entitlement and values were not probed.
availability.revisions: Current history can contain backfills/revisions and changed metadata. The exact daily finality/reorg cutoff and original vintages for these four inputs remain unproved.
availability.review_status: An older official overview describes conditional flash/reviewed/revised statuses and status-time as last human review. The four definition objects do not expose reviewable/asof/status fields; omission does not prove immutability.
availability.archive: The pinned archive generator emits current daily values and null blanks without per-value publication/asof/status history. A pinned retrieval commit supplies snapshot provenance, not original-day availability.

public_access.limit: Official conventions: 10 requests per 6 seconds per IP; no key. Generic page-size maximum is 10000, not authorization for bulk acquisition.
public_access.license: Community archive README specifies CC BY-NC 4.0; no commercial-use or expanded-dataset entitlement was established.
public_access.limitations: Community is a subset; advertised product/metric coverage is not entitlement. The four-input BTC probe does not establish broader availability.

distinct_received_mechanics.mechanics: Real-time start/end are inclusive YYYY-MM-DD boundaries. Observations default both to today, so an observation_start in the past alone still returns currently known history. For a historical day D, explicitly request realtime_start=D and realtime_end=D with output_type=1; preserve the observation date separately. This is a day-vintage request, not proof of intraday availability.

output_type=2 gives all observations by vintage date; output_type=3 gives only new/revised observations. The latter is a delta stream, not a full snapshot; retaining prior state and missing-value semantics needs a separately tested reconstruction contract. vintage_dates may include a date with no revision and can replace realtime_start/end. JSON/XML requests allow up to 2000 vintage dates; page/chunk and prove completeness rather than assume one call suffices.

output_type=4 is Initial Release Only. This is a distinct input representation, not interchangeable with the latest value known at each decision. Initial release values do not supply consensus expectations; no CPI-surprise strategy can be inferred without a timestamped expectations archive.

series/vintagedates enumerates dates with new/revised values and excludes release dates with unchanged data. Missing vintage is therefore not proof of no release. release/dates explicitly warns source release dates need not equal availability on FRED/ALFRED. include_release_dates_with_no_data defaults false; true may include future calendar dates, which are not data receipts.

Observations default units=lin and no frequency aggregation. Record series units/seasonal adjustment and requested transforms; a monthly series cannot be upsampled to daily via the frequency parameter. Lower-frequency aggregation defaults avg when requested, and avg/sum/eop are different inputs. Observations limit up to100000 with offset; vintage dates limit up to10000. Response count/offset/limit and all page hashes must be reconciled before coverage is asserted.

API v1 documentation says all web-service requests require an API key; viewing/requesting a key requires login, and each user/application has the stated key obligations. Public documentation does not establish credential readiness or authorize accessing secret values. No key inspected/requested and no API called.

distinct_received_methods.scope: HAR/HAR-X conditional mean forecast
distinct_received_methods.mechanics: HARX models the conditional mean of supplied y using averaged lags and optional finite exogenous x. If y is daily RV, its conditional mean is the RV prediction; the model residual variance is not the same target. Example lags[1,5,22] are counts of y observations, not hours or an automatically crypto-adjusted week/month. Standard overlapping, rotated non-overlapping and explicit2D lag forms are shown; the doc reports equal fitted R2 examples, not trading equivalence under regularization, restrictions or different samples. hold_back can impose a common estimation sample. No ADF, logarithmic-RV correction or positivity rule is supplied here.

distinct_received_methods.scope: Analytical ARCH/GARCH forecasts
distinct_received_methods.mechanics: The guide gives constant-mean GARCH(1,1): r_t=mu+epsilon_t; sigma2_t=omega+alpha*epsilon2_(t-1)+beta*sigma2_(t-1). Multistep recursion uses omega+(alpha+beta)*E_t[sigma2_(t+h-1)]. One-step analytical forecasts are described as available; multistep analytical availability depends on the model, e.g. squared-residual-linear GARCH/HARCH versus EGARCH. This is model conditional variance of returns, not an RV regression output.

distinct_received_methods.scope: Simulation alternative
distinct_received_methods.mechanics: Simulate fixed-count future paths with an assumed standardized residual distribution and average horizon-specific variances. First one-step forecast is fixed in the described ARCH setup; nonlinear models may benefit when analytical multistep recursion is unavailable. Paths/count/seed/distribution would need freezing; no source simulation executed.

distinct_received_methods.scope: Residual bootstrap alternative
distinct_received_methods.mechanics: Use standardized in-sample residuals with iid replacement instead of parametric shocks. Only data available at the forecast origin may enter the residual pool; the guide notes a minimum in-sample amount. This is a forecast algorithm, not a block-bootstrap significance test and not automatic dependence-robust inference.

distinct_received_methods.scope: Forecast clocks and outputs
distinct_received_methods.mechanics: align=origin defaults to indexing by last observed input; target aligns the row to the forecast observation. h.1/h.24 are1/24 observation-ahead point forecasts. h.24 is not automatically integrated next24h variance. A sum-of-step innovation-variance target and variance of a cumulative return are distinct; mean dynamics/cross-step covariance assumptions must be fixed before mapping. variance differs from residual_variance at horizons>1 when the mean has dynamics. For daily RV input, h.1 forecasts next daily RV; align target/origin and strict bar completion must be explicit.

distinct_received_methods.scope: Estimation versus forecast start
distinct_received_methods.mechanics: The guide fits with last_obs split then forecasts from start; a forecast start alone does not restrict an earlier full-sample fit. Supplied fit parameters are reused unless explicitly re-estimated. append extends model data without changing existing result objects; fitting again re-estimates.
